name: janction-render-skills
description: 10 MIT-licensed skills that teach an AI agent to render Blender well: scene preflight, render settings, color management, lighting, product shots, turntables, clay and wireframe renders, animation delivery checks, reference matching and a director that plans the job. They work with a local Blender (any Blender MCP that runs Python) and with JANCTION Render's cloud GPUs.
